subject: Post-call: procurement & payment path for Helios
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@helioshealth.com>, James Wu <james.wu@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: procurement & payment path for Helios

Hi Alyssa / James —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our side so procurement and finance have a clean runway: 

What we heard (summary)
- Legal needs: review and standard SOW language + a few security clauses.
- Security: Helios will run our security questionnaire and ask for SOC2 evidence.
- Finance: prefers a PO but will validate card vs. PO based on contract value and approval flow.
- Marketplace: procurement asked whether we can transact via AWS Marketplace (they flagged advantage for faster onboarding).

Proposed mutual action plan (high level)
1) Redwood to send: SOW draft + standard security pack (SOC2 summary, data flow diagram) — by 2026-11-17 (attachment: redwood-sow-draft.pdf).
2) Helios legal to confirm redlines target date — aim for 5 business days after receipt.
3) Helios security to complete questionnaire or signal outstanding ask — target 10 business days.
4) Finance to confirm PO path or card payment; if PO, estimate time-to-issue and routing contacts.
5) If marketplace is preferred, we’ll connect you with our partner ops and provide marketplace SKUs/pricing.

Please confirm if the timeline above maps to your internal gates and share primary contacts for Legal/Security/Finance (procurement@helioshealth.com is fine if that’s the canonical alias). I’ll follow up with the SOW and MPA template.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the MPA in motion.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: redwood-sow-draft.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@helioshealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: James Wu <james.wu@helioshealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@helioshealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement & payment path for Helios

Thanks Karthik — useful summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Legal: I’ll be the primary contact but legal will route redlines through Marcus (legal). We usually try for a 7-business-day turnaround for non-critical changes.
- Security: That will be handled by James and our security ops team; we’ll run your questionnaire but please also include a short data flow diagram with the SOW.
- Finance: We prefer PO for anything > $25k annually. For a pilot under that threshold, we can do a company card. PO issuance typically takes 10–14 business days once the SOW is signed and GL codes are provided.
- Marketplace: Procurement asked explicitly about AWS Marketplace options. If Redwood can transact there, it shortens internal approvals — please indicate whether the offering supports marketplace SKUs/pricing and any changes to billing cadence.

Next steps from Helios: I’ll confirm Marcus’ availability for legal review and loop James for security. We’ve put procurement@helioshealth.com on copy.

Alyssa Turner
Head of Strategic Procurement | Helios Health
alyssa.turner@helioshealth.com | +1 212-555-0164

Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement & payment path for Helios

Alyssa — thanks for the clarifications. Per your notes I attached the MPA template (Redwood-MPA-template.xlsx) with a proposed 4-week pilot timeline and milestone dates. Key things I adjusted:

- Legal review window: proposed 7 business days after we deliver the finalized SOW.
- Security: checkpoint at day 10 for questionnaire completion; if the security team requests additional artifacts we’ll provide the SOC2 summary and our network diagram within 48 hours of request.
- Finance & PO: added a finance deliverable to provide GL codes and budget approval by week 2 of the MPA. We also included a fallback path for card payment for first 30 days if PO delays occur.
- Marketplace: added a decision node — if Helios elects AWS Marketplace, Redwood will share SKUs and an ops contact and we’ll update billing cadence to monthly marketplace terms.

Please review the milestone table in the MPA and confirm: primary legal contact (Marcus? last name?), security lead (James?), and the person who will own PO issuance (procurement@helioshealth.com or a named contact).

If this looks good I’ll ask Marissa to review the SOW redlines and we’ll schedule a quick alignment call with your procurement lead.

Best,
— Karthik

Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement & payment path for Helios

Karthik / Alyssa — quick thumbs up from security: we got the SOC2 summary you sent and the data flow diagram looks good at a glance. We’ll aim to complete the questionnaire by 2026-11-29 and flag anything else earlier.

On procurement: procurement@helioshealth.com will own PO issuance; I’ll work with them once legal is done. For the pilot we’re leaning toward PO because annualizing the pilot would push value > $25k, and tooling-wise we prefer PO for auditability.

Happy to join the alignment call — Alyssa, please let us know who from procurement to include.

— James
